dialogue.speaker: Waiter
dialogue.text: Good evening! Did you reserve a table?

glosses.meaning: a piece of furniture where you eat
to ask a place to keep a table for you

dialogue.en: Hello! Did you ask us to keep a table?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Yes, a table for two under the name Brown.

glosses.meaning: a piece of furniture where you eat

dialogue.en: Yes, we want a table for two people, for Brown.

dialogue.speaker: Waiter
dialogue.text: Perfect. What do you recommend tonight?

glosses.meaning: to say that something is good

dialogue.en: Good. What food do you think is best tonight?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: I recommend the chicken. It is delicious.

glosses.meaning: a bird that we eat as meat
to say that something is good

dialogue.en: I say the chicken is best. It tastes very good.

dialogue.speaker: Waiter
dialogue.text: I will take the chicken, and my friend takes the pasta.

glosses.meaning: a bird that we eat as meat
an Italian food made from flour and water

dialogue.en: I choose the chicken, and my friend chooses the pasta.

dialogue.speaker: You

glosses.meaning: a sweet food at the end of a meal

dialogue.en: Good. Do you want a sweet food after?
